name: design-os-code2flow
description: Local-first AST codebase-to-user-flow mapper and 11-heuristic UX gap auditor across 7 frontend and mobile frameworks.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first AST codebase-to-user-flow mapper and 11-heuristic UX gap auditor across 7 frontend and mobile frameworks.
interface.longDescription: Statically analyze Next.js, React Router, TanStack Router, Expo Router, SwiftUI, Flutter, and Jetpack Compose repositories to generate Mermaid user-flow graphs and catch dead-end screens, missing error boundaries, and unguarded auth routes.
defaultPrompt: Scan this Next.js App Router repository with code2flow, generate the Mermaid user-flow diagram, and list all high-severity UX gaps.
Audit our SwiftUI navigation stack for dead-end screens, missing loading/error states, and unguarded destructive actions.
Export a JSON + Markdown user-flow topology report for our PR review gate.
